overviewHtml:
Twelve reproducible experiments accompany Engineering Reliable Model Systems and LLM & AI Infrastructure from First Principles. These are teaching implementations, not a deployable model-serving platform.

Setup#

From the repository root (or extracted archive root):

sh
python3 -m venv labs/.venv
labs/.venv/bin/python -m pip install -r labs/requirements.txt

Or with uv:

sh
uv run --with torch python -m unittest discover -s labs/llm/modern-transformer -p 'test_*.py' -v

Python 3.11+ and Go 1.24+ are required. Only the LLM tensor labs require PyTorch. No model downloads or API keys are used. All tensor operations explicitly run on CPU.

Test all twelve labs#

sh
(cd labs/go && go test -race ./...)
python3 -m unittest discover -s labs/python/concurrency -p 'test_*.py' -v
python3 -m unittest discover -s labs/python/streaming -p 'test_*.py' -v
labs/.venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s labs/llm/attention -p 'test_*.py' -v
labs/.venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s labs/llm/kv-cache -p 'test_*.py' -v
labs/.venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s labs/llm/modern-transformer -p 'test_*.py' -v
labs/.venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s labs/llm/roofline-flash -p 'test_*.py' -v
labs/.venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s labs/llm/deepseek-mla-grpo -p 'test_*.py' -v
labs/.venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s labs/llm/flagship-2026 -p 'test_*.py' -v
labs/.venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s labs/llm/looped-transformer -p 'test_*.py' -v
labs/.venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s labs/llm/block-diffusion -p 'test_*.py' -v

Reproduce the records#

sh
python3 labs/python/streaming/measure.py > labs/results/stream-fixture.json
labs/.venv/bin/python labs/llm/attention/attention.py
labs/.venv/bin/python labs/llm/kv-cache/benchmark.py --output labs/results/cache-results.json
labs/.venv/bin/python labs/llm/modern-transformer/modern_blocks.py
labs/.venv/bin/python labs/llm/roofline-flash/roofline_flash.py
labs/.venv/bin/python labs/llm/deepseek-mla-grpo/mla_grpo.py
labs/.venv/bin/python labs/llm/flagship-2026/flagship_blocks.py
labs/.venv/bin/python labs/llm/looped-transformer/looped_transformer.py
labs/.venv/bin/python labs/llm/block-diffusion/block_diffusion.py

The stream report uses prescribed timestamps, not a measured model. Decoder timings are local CPU microbenchmarks over a random-weight, one-block model. Compare correctness first, then timings under the same environment. Do not extrapolate these records to GPU throughput, language quality, or production capacity.

Sources and attribution#

  • The admission gate is an original reduced example informed by the local go-review project's cmd/inference-lab/main.go. It isolates admission and draining instead of copying its HTTP gateway.
  • The agent loop is an original reduced example informed by the local pi-go project's internal/agent/loop.go and tests. That project is a Go rewrite of pi-mono. This lab is not wire compatible and is not a claim to the upstream design.
  • Python concurrency and measurement implementations were created for these articles, drawing on the Python standard-library documentation.
  • Attention and decoder implementations were created for these articles and checked against PyTorch operations. The code uses synthetic inputs and does not reproduce a trained model.

The original project checkouts are not dependencies. No credentials, session history, personal progress records, or upstream project files are packaged in the download.

labs.name: attention
labs.title: Causal attention on CPU
labs.summary: Numerical verification of scaled dot-product causal attention, shape invariants, and zero-leakage future masking on CPU.

labs.name: block-diffusion
labs.title: Block Masked Diffusion LM: NELBO & Parallel Unmasking Lab
labs.summary: Block-causal masking, confidence-thresholded parallel unmasking, and KV-cached prefix reuse for discrete diffusion LLMs.

labs.name: deepseek-mla-grpo
labs.title: DeepSeek MLA Matrix Absorption & GRPO Advantage Lab
labs.summary: Low-rank KV latent compression, RoPE key decoupling, weight-matrix absorption, and critic-free GRPO advantage normalization.

labs.name: flagship-2026
labs.title: 2026 Flagship Co-Design: CED KV Sharing, Depth Routing & Muon Lab
labs.summary: Asymmetric compressed-encoder decoding (CED), depth-wise attention residuals (AttnRes), and 5-step Newton-Schulz Muon orthogonalization.

labs.name: kv-cache
labs.title: A tiny cached decoder
labs.summary: Incremental key-value state caching vs. full recomputation, verifying exact floating-point logit parity across decode steps.

labs.name: looped-transformer
labs.title: Looped Transformer: Elastic Depth & Terminal KV Lab
labs.summary: Recurrent shared-weight depth iteration, terminal-loop constant KV cache, and adaptive compute halting criteria.

labs.name: modern-transformer
labs.title: Modern Transformer Blocks Lab
labs.summary: Complex-plane RoPE rotation invariance, SwiGLU gating dynamics, and RMSNorm gradient stability checks in pure PyTorch.

labs.name: roofline-flash
labs.title: Roofline & Online Tiled Attention Lab
labs.summary: Online Softmax blockwise tiling and HBM/SRAM arithmetic-intensity roofline verification against naive quadratic attention.

labs.name: agent
labs.title: A deterministic Go agent loop
labs.summary: Deterministic tool-use state machine with bounded step budgets, structured error recovery, and context-driven cancellation.

labs.name: gateway
labs.title: Bounded admission in Go
labs.summary: Semaphore-bounded admission control, per-request timeout propagation, and graceful server draining tested under Go's race detector.

labs.name: concurrency
labs.title: Structured concurrency
labs.summary: Structured asyncio.TaskGroup fan-out, semaphore backpressure, and fail-fast cancellation across heterogeneous tool calls.

labs.name: streaming
labs.title: Streaming measurement
labs.summary: Time-to-first-token (TTFT) and inter-token latency (ITL) quantile telemetry over asynchronous server-sent event streams.
